translations.heroTitle: Business-Side IT Project Advisory: Scoping, Governance and IT Project Delivery
translations.heroIntro: OLING supports business and IT departments with the scoping, governance and management of transformation projects involving ERP, digital workplaces, data, compliance and cybersecurity.
translations.heroSideHtml:
Our value

Business-side IT project advisory that strengthens decision-making and accelerates delivery

Our role is to turn your business needs into actionable IT roadmaps. We structure requirements, support evidence-based decisions, coordinate stakeholders and ensure compliance throughout the project.

What we deliver

  • Scoping, requirements definition, and process and risk mapping.
  • IT strategy, business case and prioritised roadmap.
  • Governance, project management, acceptance testing, change management and results measurement.

Areas of expertise

  • ERP / CRM / CMMS / financial systems / IT infrastructure project advisory
  • Data, BI and data governance
  • GDPR, AI Act, ISO 27001, NIS2 and DORA compliance
  • Cybersecurity and IT security, regulatory compliance, e-invoicing advisory
Method

Our three-step IT project advisory method

Structure, secure, transform: a clear framework for reliable IT projects.

01

Assessment and scoping

IT audit, mapping, business objectives and requirements.

02

Governance and management

Operational business-side advisory, PMO, budget, risks and integrated compliance.

03

Change management

Adoption, training and performance measurement.

Schedule a consultation

Related IT project advisory guides

  • Business-side IT project scoping: 10 mistakes to avoid
  • Choosing an IT project advisory firm for SMEs and mid-sized companies
  • Regulatory compliance: GDPR, AI Act, ISO, security, QSE and energy
  • View all resources

Client cases and projects

IT roadmaps successfully put into action

Example engagements

  • Multi-stakeholder IT scoping with a prioritised roadmap and programme governance.
  • Business-side ERP/CRM/CMMS project management with reduced rework during acceptance testing.
  • Compliance integrated from the scoping stage onwards—GDPR, AI Act, ISO and cybersecurity—to prevent late-stage roadblocks.

Sectors covered

  • Public sector
  • Infrastructure and services
  • Finance and support functions
  • Energy and environment
  • Quality and operational performance

translations.title: Cybersecurity: governance, ISO 27001, NIS2 & DORA | OLING
translations.seoTitle: Cybersecurity: governance, ISO 27001, NIS2 & DORA | OLING
translations.seoDescription: OLING supports organisations with cybersecurity governance, risk analysis, ISO 27001, NIS2, DORA, business continuity and disaster recovery, and security action plan implementation.
translations.heroTitle: Cybersecurity consulting: governance, risk and compliance
translations.heroIntro: OLING supports executive teams, IT departments and Chief Information Security Officers in assessing risks, structuring information security governance, achieving ISO 27001, NIS2 and DORA compliance, and preparing and managing action plans.
translations.heroSideHtml:
Challenges addressed

  • Non-existent or difficult-to-manage information security governance.
  • Incomplete information security policies, risk maps or security plans.
  • ISO 27001, NIS2 or DORA preparation without sufficient evidence.
  • Untested business continuity and disaster recovery plans, with poorly managed supplier dependencies.
  • Poorly formalised cybersecurity responsibilities, incidents and action plans.

OLING's positioning

OLING helps secure information systems and organisations against cyber risks and regulatory requirements. Its services focus on consulting, assessment, scoping, governance, compliance, continuity and action plan management.

OLING does not position itself as a Security Operations Centre, security integrator or penetration testing provider when these needs require specialist organisations.

Cybersecurity services

Structure governance, risk and compliance

Assessment and risk

Maturity assessments, gap analysis, risk mapping, prioritisation and remediation planning.

Information security governance

Roles, committees, information security policies, metrics, decision-making and security action plan management.

ISO 27001 and ISMS

ISMS scoping, scope definition, documentation, controls, evidence and audit preparation. OLING is ISO 27001:2022 certified.

NIS2 and DORA

Gap analysis, governance, risk management, incidents, suppliers, resilience and compliance documentation.

Continuity and resilience

BIA, BCP, DRP, RTO, RPO, crisis procedures, recovery strategies, testing and return to normal operations.

Tool-supported management

Track risks, audits, actions, controls, evidence and incidents with MAPSI when the organisation needs to standardise and scale its processes.

Method

A five-stage roadmap

  1. Assess the security posture, critical assets and applicable requirements.
  2. Prioritise risks, gaps and management decisions.
  3. Structure information security governance, the ISMS, policies and responsibilities.
  4. Implement the treatment plan, evidence and metrics.
  5. Manage, test, correct and prepare for reviews or audits.
Deliverables

What the engagement should deliver

  • Maturity assessment and gap analysis report.
  • Risk map and treatment plan.
  • Security roadmap, information security policy, supporting policies and procedures.
  • ISMS documentation, information security dashboards and compliance evidence.
  • Business continuity and disaster recovery plans, crisis procedures, testing plan and lessons-learned report.
Experience and operating environments

Proven experience across IT, compliance and resilience contexts

OLING works across mainland France and the French overseas departments and regions with public organisations, SMEs, mid-sized companies, ports, local authorities, mutual insurance organisations, water-sector operators, training providers and multi-site environments.

  • Publishable references: IT governance, GDPR, digital strategy roadmaps, telecommunications, action plans and MAPSI-based management.
  • References to remain anonymous until approval to disclose names: DORA, critical assets, risk and digital resilience.
  • Available expertise: senior IT consultants, compliance, audit, quality, safety and environment, GDPR, and sensitive transformation management.

OLING's value lies in connecting business decisions, information systems, compliance, evidence, continuity and operational delivery.

Complementary services

Connect cybersecurity, compliance and IT transformation

Explore information security auditing, governance and ISO 27001 preparation services in greater depth.

GDPR and data governance

Align security, data processing, processors and compliance evidence.

MAPSI

Manage risks, audits, action plans, controls and documentation within a single tool.

OLING resources

Explore guides on cybersecurity, NIS2/DORA, business continuity and disaster recovery, GDPR and IT scoping.

translations.heroIntro: OLING supports public-sector organisations, SMEs and mid-sized companies throughout their GDPR roadmap: assessment, action planning, management, awareness and continuous improvement.
translations.heroSideHtml:
What we put in place

  • Mapping of processing activities and risk analysis.
  • GDPR records, policies and contractual clauses.
  • DPO coordination, data subject rights requests and evidence of compliance.

Target outcomes

  • Documented compliance that can withstand an audit.
  • Reduced legal, reputational and operational risks.
  • Data governance aligned with the IT strategy.

Related guides

  • GDPR records of processing activities: an operational method
  • GDPR DPIA: when to start and how to conduct one
  • Regulatory compliance: GDPR, AI Act, ISO, security, QSE and energy

Client cases and projects

GDPR frameworks ready for audit

Examples of engagements

  • Structuring records of processing activities, gap assessments and compliance plans.
  • Establishing governance across DPO, IT and business teams, with clear responsibilities.
  • Producing evidence—policies, procedures and supporting records—that can be used during inspections.

Sectors covered

  • Public sector
  • Infrastructure and services
  • Finance and support functions
  • Energy and environment
  • Quality and operational performance
View references Start scoping your project

Related MAPSI tools

This expertise can be scaled with MAPSI to strengthen traceability, workflows and audit evidence.
